name: Microsoft Azure
how_to_set: Free and credit-based subscriptions: keep the spending limit on (Cost Management > Subscriptions > spending limit).
Pay-as-you-go: Cost Management > Budgets > Add (monthly, your amount, alerts at 80/100% actual and forecast) or deploy infra/budgets/azure/budget.bicep.
Optional: attach an action group to the budget that runs an automation to stop resources.
kill_switch: Spending limit (credit subscriptions only) disables services at the limit; pay-as-you-go budgets only alert unless an action group automation stops resources.
traps: Premium disks and public IPs bill while VMs are stopped (not deallocated)
Cost data lags up to a day
